cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import stat
from pathlib import Path
project = Path("/workspace/project").resolve()
total = 0
entries = 0
for path in project.rglob("*"):
    info = path.lstat()
    entries += 1
    if path.is_symlink() or not (stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)):
        raise ValueError("non-regular entry: %s" % path)
    if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        if info.st_nlink != 1:
            raise ValueError("hard link: %s" % path)
        total += info.st_size
print("entries", entries, "bytes", total, "ok", entries <= 256 and total <= 8*1024*1024)
for path in sorted(project.rglob("*")):
    print("  ", path.relative_to(project))
PY
